contribution.position: Restating my position on the reliability axis: the change is not yet in a defensible state. Peak-load run_time is 118s against a 60s budget (nearly 2x over, per artifact:perf-report), and artifact:incident-log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms — precisely the failure mode an over-budget, slow-running report generator is most likely to aggravate under load. The green test suite in artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) does not close this gap, since unit-level correctness says nothing about peak-load behavior. Before the reliability question can be settled, we need evidence that the 118s peak run_time is either remediated or demonstrably non-interacting with the retry-storm failure mode: load tests with realistic concurrency and retry behavior, plus a stated error-budget impact analysis.
